name: inspira-grid
description: A full-stack collaborative platform for students, creators, and developers

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm run server:install && npm run web:install
scripts.build:server: cd server && npm run build 2>nul || echo 'No build script for server'
scripts.build:all: npm run build:server && npm run web:build
scripts.clean: npm run clean:web && npm run clean:server
scripts.clean:web: cd web && (rmdir /s /q .next 2>nul || echo 'No .next directory') && (rmdir /s /q node_modules 2>nul || echo 'No node_modules in web')
scripts.clean:server: cd server && (rmdir /s /q node_modules 2>nul || echo 'No node_modules in server')
scripts.fresh-install: npm run clean && npm run install-all

author: Inspira-Grid Team
